visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Last Digit Is Skipped
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The digits of 305 add up to 8, but the program prints 5. One digit never gets added.

solution.explanation: With n > 9 the loop stops as soon as one digit is left, so the first digit (3) is never added. The loop must run while any digit remains, which is n > 0.
